answer: A payout is split thus 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The haven schedule is applied in pearl and kernel shows each instalment. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2521 identities would post 3931 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
